title: Loop Length Configuration
description: Custom loop length transformations for Rekordbox to Traktor conversion

loopLengthMappings.description: Transform loop lengths during conversion. Keys are source lengths (in bars), values are target lengths.
loopLengthMappings.comment: Set enabled to true to activate loop transformations

barMappings.description: Map loop lengths in bars (assumes 4 beats per bar)
barMappings.comment: Example: '4': 8 means all 4-bar loops become 8-bar loops

beatMappings.description: Map loop lengths in beats (more precise control)
beatMappings.comment: Takes precedence over barMappings if both match

customRules.comment: multiplyAll: 2 doubles all loop lengths, divideAll: 2 halves them
